teaser: A locked drawer holds the receipts nobody else has read. Life path 7 is called The Seeker, and crossed with the ISFJ — The Defender — it makes a particular kind of custodian: one who keeps the proof instead of just the peace. The 7 wants solitude and the long private chase toward understanding; the ISFJ wants steady care for the people close by. In this crossing, the seeking turns inward and down, toward the household rather than away from it — a privacy built to protect others as much as to protect the thinking going on inside it.
